$comment: L2G-05-CHART-REF-OTHER: chart-element menu rows + references/other dialog L4 rows. Chart rows (chart.axis-titles/data-labels/error-bars/legend/trendline/up-down-bars) run the two-step trigger: pre chart-selection picks the fixture chart (reveals the contextual chart-design tab), selector clicks the 'Chart elements ▾' rb-menu trigger, post clicks the chartElement item — toggleChartElement rewrites img[data-spec] with elements.<flag>:true (attr on fixture). references.dlg-* gate the dialog surfaces of the shared-token rows; dialog.*.l4 gate the pinned L4 dialog routes from the census evidence (each opened via its real ribbon control).

chart.axis-titles.note: ledger row: chart.axis-titles (menu:Chart elements ▾) — two-step contract: chart-selection pre clicks the fixture chart so the contextual chart-design tab activates, selector opens the 'Chart elements ▾' rb-menu (index.html), post clicks the axisTitles item; toggleChartElement flips spec.elements.axisTitles and rerenderChart rewrites img[data-spec] (editor.js:13710) — asserted on the fixture attr

chart.data-labels.note: ledger row: chart.data-labels (menu:Chart elements ▾) — same two-step as chart.axis-titles; dataLabels is type-agnostic (not in CHART_ELEMENT_SUPPORT), so the bar fixture toggles and data-spec gains "dataLabels":true

chart.error-bars.note: ledger row: chart.error-bars (menu:Chart elements ▾) — same two-step; CHART_ELEMENT_SUPPORT allows errorBars on bar/line/area (editor.js:13705), so the fixture bar chart toggles and data-spec gains "errorBars":true

chart.legend.note: ledger row: chart.legend (menu:Chart elements ▾) — same two-step; legend is type-agnostic, fixture bar chart toggles and data-spec gains "legend":true

chart.trendline.note: ledger row: chart.trendline (menu:Chart elements ▾) — same two-step; trendline is NOT gated by CHART_ELEMENT_SUPPORT (the map only holds upDownBars/errorBars, editor.js:13705 — the older ctx-chart note claiming a bar-chart gate is stale), fixture bar chart toggles and data-spec gains "trendline":true

chart.up-down-bars.note: ledger row: chart.up-down-bars (menu:Chart elements ▾) — same two-step as chart.axis-titles but on the chart-selection-line pre: CHART_ELEMENT_SUPPORT limits upDownBars to line charts (editor.js:13529 chartElementSupported) and the line-type fixture passes the gate, so toggleChartElement flips spec.elements.upDownBars and rerenderChart rewrites img[data-spec] with "upDownBars":true

dialog.link-dialog.l4.note: ledger row: dialog.link-dialog.l4 (L4 pinned, evidence: 'opened via real route: click #btn-link') — #btn-link click -> insertLink -> #link-dialog with the OO Text to display/URL fields (2/2 L4 field parity)

dialog.table-dialog.l4.note: ledger row: dialog.table-dialog.l4 (L4 pinned, evidence: 'opens via real clicks (Insert tab + #btn-table); title Insert table, Rows/Columns number fields') — insertTable() adds .open to the anchored #table-dialog insert-pop with defaults 2/3 (editor.js:2121); the insert mutation itself is contracted at table.table

dialog.equation-dialog.l4.note: ledger row: dialog.equation-dialog.l4 (L4 pinned, evidence: 'opened via real route: click #btn-equation (tab insert)') — btnEquation click -> openDlg("equation-dialog") with the OO Linear notation/Preview fields (editor.js:13941)

dialog.pagecolor-dialog.l4.note: ledger row: dialog.pagecolor-dialog.l4 (L4 pinned, evidence: 'opened via real route: click #pagecolor (tab layout)') — OO-parity palette dialog: the #pagecolor preview input's click handler preventDefaults the native picker and calls openPageColorDialog() -> openOverlayDialog("pagecolor-dialog") (editor.js:6602)

dialog.comment-dialog.l4.note: ledger row: dialog.comment-dialog.l4 (L4 pinned, evidence: 'opened via real route: click #btn-comment (tab collaboration)') — commentBtn click -> openCommentDialog -> #comment-dialog (editor.js:8730)

dialog.compare-dialog.l4.note: ledger row: dialog.compare-dialog.l4 (L4 pinned, evidence: 'opened via real route: click [data-cmd=compareVersion] (tab collaboration)') — openCompareView -> #compare-dialog with the OO 'Select document to compare' surface; the offline compare itself is the declared not-provable divergence, only the dialog is gated

dialog.combine-dialog.l4.note: ledger row: dialog.combine-dialog.l4 (L4 pinned, evidence: 'opened via real route: click [data-cmd=combineRevisions] (tab collaboration)') — openCombineView -> #combine-dialog; same offline divergence as compare, only the dialog is gated

dialog.textfromfile-dialog.l4.note: ledger row: dialog.textfromfile-dialog.l4 (L4 pinned, evidence: 'opened via real route: click #btn-textfile (tab insert)') — btnTextFile click -> openDlg("textfromfile-dialog") with the OO 'Choose file…' field (editor.js:12828)

dialog.field-dialog.l4.note: ledger row: dialog.field-dialog.l4 (L4 pinned, evidence: 'opened via real route: click #btn-field (tab references)') — btnField click -> openDlg("field-dialog") with the OO 'Field type' select (editor.js:13176)

references.dlg-bookmarks.note: ledger row: references.dlg-bookmarks (dialog:Bookmarks, token bookmark-dialog shared with references.bookmark) — same WO opener: data-cmd=bookmark -> openBookmarkDialog -> #bookmark-dialog; the OO manage-list controls (Sort by / Hidden bookmarks / Go to / Delete) are the declared divergence noted at references.bookmark, the insert surface is what WO ships

references.dlg-insert-caption.note: ledger row: references.dlg-insert-caption PROMOTED 2026-11-07 (L2M-07) — the OO Insert caption dialog exists now: References-tab Caption (data-cmd=insertCaption) opens #caption-dialog (openCaptionDialog; in DIALOG_IDS), fields Caption text + Label select + 'Exclude label from caption'/Numbering/'Include chapter number'/'Use separator' checkboxes + 'Chapter starts with style' select, buttons OK/Cancel; OK (ROUND2 -> confirmCaptionDialog) inserts the centered caption paragraph node-by-node carrying the typed text (em.wo-caption marker — insertHTML's sanitizer strips classes, same lesson as insertCitation; the marker also disambiguates from the sample doc's pre-existing 'Abbildung 1:' caption em). Declared divergence (census fidelity): OO's custom-label controls (Insert field, Add label/Delete label buttons) are not shipped — WO offers fixed Figure/Table/Equation labels
